title: $αβ$-Tessarine Toolbox: A high-performance MATLAB framework for hypercomplex tensor algebra
summary: The \textit{$αβ$-Tessarine Toolbox} is introduced as a high-performance MATLAB framework for generalized hypercomplex tensor algebra. By implementing the $αβ$-tessarine mathematical structure, a strictly more general environment than existing quaternion or limited tessarine packages is provided. This open-source software bridges abstract theoretical models and experimental applications, allowing researchers to efficiently solve multidimensional problems.
